name: struct2flow-blueprint
description: Test harness for the struct2flow blueprint's own regression suites (TASK-018). Lives under tests/, which is a blueprint-managed directory no derived project owns a copy of — so it cannot collide with a project's own root package.json (TASK-020).
_engineNote: Floor set by vitest 4.1.11's transitive vite@8/rolldown, verified by npm EBADENGINE on node v20.11.0. vitest 4.1.11 is also the FIRST version clear of GHSA-82fw-gwwq-j7x9 (CVSS 5.9), which osv-scanner blocks — so this floor is a security requirement, not a preference. scripts/install-toolchain.sh must assert it as a capability: `command -v node` is true for a Node that cannot run the harness.
